apps.name: Fluxa
apps.subtitle: Your media, in one place.
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed

- fix(profiles): open the picker on start when no profile is active (`30a886e4`)
- feat(android): compose-style text selection handles and toolbar (`4bfef499`)
- fix(welcome): let the user create the first profile (`9b8b8753`)
- fix(core): require welcome after logout until signed in or offline (`b4ec65dd`)
- fix(ui): keep input focus through layout probe pass (`a03a84ad`)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FluxaMedia/fluxa/compare/v0.3.7...v0.3.8
